assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production 2.5D pixel fantasy tower-defense basic-attack VFX sprite sheet.
Draw an actual animated effect atlas, not a concept diagram. Exactly FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS of equal square cells, 16 cells total, square canvas. Genuine transparent background. No grid, labels, text, character, weapon wielder, environment, ground rectangle or opaque backplate. Every frame has wide transparent gutters and no marks touching cell edges.
All flight sprites aim horizontally RIGHT. Crisp intentionally drawn pixel clusters, restrained soft light only next to the bright core, detailed fantasy game art readable at 40 pixels, not thick geometric primitives or smooth vector clipart.
ROW 1: four looping flight-head frames, same head silhouette and size centered in each cell, subtly changing internal animation. Head should fill about 55% cell width.
ROW 2: four looping detached wake/trail ribbon frames, long and slim, flowing from LEFT into its emission point at x=80% of the cell and y=50%; whole trail confined between x=12% and80%, within middle 32% cell height. No projectile head in row2. Transparent behind it.
ROW 3: impact sequence frames1-4: small contact flash, expanding characteristic impact, peak impact, beginning breakup. Centered at cell center.
ROW 4: impact sequence frames5-8: continuing dissipate progressively to almost empty final wisps; don't restart explosion. Keep all eight impacts compact, not a huge ultimate spell.
Subject: a slender enchanted dark-elf arrow made of silver and lavender moonlight. Row1 visible elegant silver arrowhead, dark violet thin shaft and subtle crescent-shaped fletching; a focused lunar glint at the tip. Row2 two fine curved lavender/silver streams with sparse tiny stardust, airy and not smoky. Impact is a small ivory-violet star contact with a delicate crescent ripple and a few angular silver moon shards, eight-frame burst and fade. Mood mystical moonlit, pale violet, silver-white, deep purple outlines.
